title: Spacious Condo Steps to Downtown + FREE Parking!
description:
Our nearly 1100 sqft 2nd floor condo in a secured building gives you the space you expect and the convenience of everything downtown and then some!

Step outside and WALK to everything Broadway, Bridgestone or the Ryman in 5 short minutes. Nissan Stadium is <1 mi. 

Located truly the heart of Nashville, our 1 bedroom condo (but with 1 king sized and 1 queen sized bed) will be everything you need during your Nashville adventures! Free coffee, washer and dryer in-unit as well.

The space
Exposed beams, 10+ foot ceilings, exposed brick. A true open feel loft throughout and will provide plenty of space for everyone. The building and elevator also have codes for entry access providing additional security.

For the bed layout / locations:

We're fortunate that our layout maximizes guest separation!

The bedroom is at the entrance of the unit and the Queen murphy bed (with a real queen mattress) is at the opposite end of the condo by the front facing windows.

Guest access
Free covered parking right next to the building (1 car only).
